2607.16692.title: Dependency-Guided Code Generation: Structured Matrix Decomposition and Consistency-Guided Refinement
2607.16692.paper_summary: The increasing complexity of modern software systems has made automated code generation a fundamental task in software engineering. However, existing approaches often fail to adequately capture the intricate, multi-level dependencies among code entities, leading to generated code that is logically incomplete or difficult to integrate into real-world systems. To address this limitation, we propose a dependency-aware code generation framework that explicitly models interactions among code entities through a graph-based representation. We decompose dependencies into two complementary components: a quantized matrix that captures strong, explicit relations, and a sparse low-rank factorization that models weaker, implicit interactions. The decomposition is efficiently learned via an alternating optimization procedure. During code generation, the learned dependency structure is incorporated as a constraint, ensuring both semantic coherence and structural consistency of the generated code. Furthermore, we introduce a sparse triplet representation for strong dependencies, significantly improving storage efficiency and computational scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently produces code with superior semantic alignment and structural fidelity compared to existing methods.
2607.16692.paper_summary_zh: 現代軟體系統日益複雜，使得自動化程式碼生成成為軟體工程中的一項基本任務。<lb/>然而，現有的方法往往未能充分捕捉程式碼實體之間錯綜複雜的多層依賴關係，導致生成的程式碼在邏輯上不完整或難以整合進入現實世界的系統中。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了一個依賴感知的程式碼生成框架，通過基於圖的表示明確建模程式碼實體之間的互動。<lb/>我們將依賴關係分解為兩個互補的組件：一個量化矩陣用於捕捉強烈、明確的關係，以及一個稀疏低秩分解用於建模較弱、隱含的互動。<lb/>這一分解通過交替優化程序高效學習而來。<lb/>在程式碼生成過程中，學習到的依賴結構被納入約束，確保生成的程式碼在語義一致性和結構一致性方面都達到要求。<lb/>此外，我們引入了一種稀疏三元組表示法來表示強依賴，顯著提高了存儲效率和計算可擴展性。<lb/>大量實驗表明，我們的方法在語義對齊和結構保真度上，始終優於現有方法。
